offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_en: Winter LPG bills ($80k–$250k/yr per ha) and Botrytis fungal rot from cold damp nights.
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_fr: Factures de gaz GPL hivernales (80k–250k $/an/ha) et pourriture grise (Botrytis) liée à l'humidité froide.
offtaker_archetypes.recommended_tier: Tier 3 (250 kW Skid) or Tier 4 (1 MW Inverted Matrix Pod)

offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_en: Slow winter root strike; NSW mines need millions of native tubestock seedlings for mandatory land rehab.
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_fr: Enracinement hivernal lent ; besoin massif de plants indigènes pour réhabiliter les mines du NSW.
offtaker_archetypes.recommended_tier: Tier 2 (BitPlant 15–50 kW) or Tier 3 (250 kW Nursery Hub)

offtaker_archetypes.sector_en: Protected Cropping (Truss Tomatoes, Berries, Asian Greens)
offtaker_archetypes.sector_fr: Maraîchage sous Serre (Tomates, Baies, Légumes Feuilles)
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_en: High winter gas costs block year-round contracts with Sydney supermarkets (Flemington Markets).
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_fr: Le coût du chauffage au gaz bloque la production 4 saisons vers le marché de Sydney.
offtaker_archetypes.recommended_tier: Tier 4 (1 MW Inverted Matrix -> heats 6,500–8,000 m² glasshouse)

offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_en: 24/7 year-round flat thermal load (not just winter!), making immersion compute a 365-day 100% heat match.
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_fr: Besoin thermique constant 365 j/an (pasteurisation 65°C + bassins 28°C), idéal pour le minage 24/7.

offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_en: Summer heat sink! Absorbs 100% of compute heat during hot NSW months when greenhouses need zero heating.
offtaker_archetypes.pain_point_fr: Exutoire estival idéal : absorbe 100 % de la chaleur en été quand les serres n'ont plus besoin de chauffage.
